/* =========================================================
PM CONTENT DISCOVERY DESIGN V5
Blogger 기본 위젯 구조는 보존하고 화면만 재구성합니다.
========================================================= */
:root{
--pm-bg:#ffffff;
--pm-surface:#ffffff;
--pm-soft:#f6f7fb;
--pm-text:#17181c;
--pm-muted:#777b85;
--pm-line:#e9eaf0;
--pm-accent:#5265f5;
--pm-accent-dark:#3e50d9;
--pm-accent-soft:#eef0ff;
--pm-shadow-sm:0 4px 16px rgba(27,31,55,.06);
--pm-shadow-md:0 14px 40px rgba(27,31,55,.10);
--pm-radius-sm:12px;
--pm-radius-md:20px;
--pm-radius-lg:28px;
--pm-max:1120px;
--pm-header:68px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
margin:0!important;
background:var(--pm-bg)!important;
color:var(--pm-text)!important;
font-family:Pretendard,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif!important;
font-size:16px;
line-height:1.55;
-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
body.pm-menu-open{overflow:hidden}
a{text-decoration:none}
.pm-container{width:min(calc(100% - 40px),var(--pm-max));margin:0 auto}
.pm-visually-hidden{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;padding:0!important;margin:-1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border:0!important}
/* Blogger 기본 외형 제거, 위젯과 게시물 데이터는 유지 */
.bg-photo-container,.bg-photo-overlay,.centered-top-container,.centered-top-placeholder,.sidebar-container{display:none!important}
.page{width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important}
.page_body{position:relative!important;z-index:1!important;background:transparent!important}
.page_body .centered{max-width:var(--pm-max)!important;min-height:0!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:34px 20px 70px!important}
.page_body .centered-bottom{padding:0!important}
#footer{display:none!important}
body.pm-home-view .page_body{
display:none!important;
}
/* 상단 헤더 */
.pm-site-header{
position:sticky;
top:0;
z-index:900;
height:var(--pm-header);
background:rgba(255,255,255,.93);
border-bottom:1px solid rgba(233,234,240,.92);
backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
}
.pm-header-inner{height:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.pm-icon-btn{width:42px;height:42px;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;padding:0;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;color:var(--pm-text)}
.pm-icon-btn:hover{background:var(--pm-soft)}
.pm-icon-btn svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.pm-brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;justify-self:start;min-width:0;color:var(--pm-text)!important}
.pm-brand-mark{width:36px;height:36px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:13px;color:#fff;font-size:22px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;background:conic-gradient(from 210deg,#5669ff,#985cff,#f062aa,#ffae45,#5669ff);box-shadow:0 9px 22px rgba(102,82,238,.3)}
.pm-brand-name{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-family:'Jua',Pretendard,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.015em;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#5746e8 0%,#8e4edb 45%,#e35b9a 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:#684de0;transform:rotate(-1deg);transform-origin:left center}
.pm-desktop-nav{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px}
.pm-desktop-nav a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;color:#555965!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:650}
.pm-desktop-nav a:hover{color:var(--pm-text)!important;background:var(--pm-soft)}
.pm-desktop-nav .pm-reading-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-left:4px;color:var(--pm-accent-dark)!important;background:var(--pm-accent-soft)}
.pm-desktop-nav .pm-reading-link:before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pm-accent)}
.pm-header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.pm-all-link{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--pm-accent);color:#fff!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:750}
.pm-all-link:hover{background:var(--pm-accent-dark);color:#fff!important}
/* 모바일 메뉴 */
.pm-drawer-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:950;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;background:rgba(15,17,25,.42);transition:.22s ease}
.pm-mobile-drawer{position:fixed;inset:0 auto 0 0;z-index:960;width:min(86vw,340px);padding:20px;transform:translateX(-102%);background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-md);transition:transform .25s ease;overflow-y:auto}
.pm-menu-open .pm-drawer-backdrop{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.pm-menu-open .pm-mobile-drawer{transform:translateX(0)}
.pm-drawer-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:24px}
.pm-drawer-brand{font-family:'Jua',Pretendard,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-size:25px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.015em;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#5746e8 0%,#8e4edb 45%,#e35b9a 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:#684de0}
.pm-drawer-nav{display:grid;gap:5px}
.pm-drawer-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 12px;border-radius:12px;color:var(--pm-text)!important;font-weight:650}
.pm-drawer-nav a:hover{background:var(--pm-soft)}
.pm-drawer-reading{margin-top:10px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--pm-line)}
.pm-drawer-reading>a{color:var(--pm-accent-dark)!important;background:var(--pm-accent-soft)}
.pm-drawer-reading-title{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.pm-drawer-reading-title svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.pm-drawer-reading-posts{display:grid;gap:2px;margin:8px 4px 0}
.pm-drawer-reading-posts:empty{display:none}
.pm-drawer-reading-posts a{display:block;min-width:0;padding:8px 10px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:9px;color:#5d65a8!important;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.35;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.pm-drawer-reading-posts a:hover{background:var(--pm-accent-soft)}
.pm-drawer-note{margin:24px 0 0;padding:16px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--pm-accent-soft);color:#4b55a7;font-size:13px}
/* 검색창 */
.pm-search-layer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:980;display:grid;place-items:start center;padding:12vh 20px 30px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;background:rgba(21,23,32,.52);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);transition:.2s ease}
.pm-search-layer.pm-open{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.pm-search-box{width:min(100%,640px);padding:18px;border-radius:22px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.pm-search-form{display:flex;gap:10px}
.pm-search-input{flex:1;min-width:0;height:52px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--pm-line);border-radius:14px;outline:0;color:var(--pm-text);background:#fff}
.pm-search-input:focus{border-color:var(--pm-accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--pm-accent-soft)}
.pm-search-submit{height:52px;padding:0 20px;border:0;border-radius:14px;color:#fff;background:var(--pm-accent);font-weight:750;cursor:pointer}
.pm-search-help{margin:12px 4px 0;color:var(--pm-muted);font-size:13px}
/* 홈페이지 */
.pm-home-main{padding:28px 0 78px;background:#fff}
.pm-hero-shell{position:relative;margin-bottom:44px}
.pm-hero-slider{position:relative;min-height:385px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--pm-radius-lg);background:#e8eaff;box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-sm)}
.pm-hero-slide{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateX(18px);transition:opacity .45s ease,transform .45s ease;color:var(--pm-text)!important}
.pm-hero-slide.pm-active{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translateX(0)}
.pm-hero-copy{z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:52px 34px 62px 58px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f1f2ff 0%,#e5e8ff 100%)}
.pm-hero-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-self:flex-start;margin-bottom:18px;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.76);color:var(--pm-accent-dark);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em}
.pm-hero-title{display:-webkit-box;max-width:520px;margin:0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;font-size:clamp(31px,4.1vw,52px);line-height:1.14;letter-spacing:-.055em;color:var(--pm-text)}
.pm-hero-desc{display:-webkit-box;max-width:520px;margin:17px 0 24px;overflow:hidden;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;color:#5c6070;font-size:15px}
.pm-hero-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;align-self:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:13px 18px;border-radius:999px;color:#fff;background:var(--pm-accent);font-size:14px;font-weight:750}
.pm-hero-media{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#d9dcff}
.pm-hero-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.pm-hero-media:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(229,232,255,.35),transparent 30%)}
.pm-hero-placeholder{width:100%;height:100%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 32%,rgba(255,255,255,.86) 0 10%,transparent 10.5%),radial-gradient(circle at 35% 70%,rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0 13%,transparent 13.5%),linear-gradient(135deg,#94a0ff,#5c6df0)}
.pm-hero-dots{position:absolute;z-index:5;left:58px;bottom:23px;display:flex;gap:6px}
.pm-hero-dot{width:7px;height:7px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(54,61,110,.25);cursor:pointer;transition:width .2s ease,background .2s ease}
.pm-hero-dot.pm-active{width:22px;background:var(--pm-accent)}
.pm-content-section{margin-top:46px}
.pm-section-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:18px}
.pm-section-title{margin:0;font-size:24px;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.045em;color:var(--pm-text)}
.pm-section-subtitle{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--pm-muted);font-size:14px}
.pm-section-more{flex:0 0 auto;color:#626774!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:700}
.pm-section-more:hover{color:var(--pm-accent)!important}
.pm-card-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px 18px}
.pm-card-rail{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:calc((100% - 54px)/4);gap:18px;overflow-x:auto;overscroll-behavior-inline:contain;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;padding:2px 2px 14px;scrollbar-width:thin}
.pm-card{min-width:0;scroll-snap-align:start}
.pm-card-link{display:block;color:var(--pm-text)!important}
.pm-card-thumb{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1/1;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--pm-radius-md);background:#eceefe;box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-sm)}
.pm-card-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .35s ease}
.pm-card-link:hover .pm-card-thumb img{transform:scale(1.035)}
.pm-card-placeholder{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#909cff,#5365ee);color:#fff;font-size:36px;font-weight:850}
.pm-card-badge{position:absolute;left:12px;top:12px;min-width:32px;height:32px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:var(--pm-accent-dark);font-size:12px;font-weight:850;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.09)}
.pm-card-title{display:-webkit-box;margin:13px 2px 0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.025em;color:var(--pm-text);font-weight:750}
.pm-card-meta{margin:7px 2px 0;color:#9296a0;font-size:12px}
.pm-empty{padding:40px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--pm-line);border-radius:18px;color:var(--pm-muted);text-align:center;background:var(--pm-soft)}
.pm-loading{min-height:385px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#73798b;font-weight:650}
/* 검색 유입용 읽을거리: 테스트 카드와 구분되는 매거진형 카드 */
.pm-editorial-section{padding:28px;border:1px solid #e1e4ff;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fbfbff,#f7f8ff)}
.pm-editorial-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}
.pm-editorial-card{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--pm-line);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-sm);transition:transform .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease}
.pm-editorial-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-md)}
.pm-editorial-link{display:grid;grid-template-columns:124px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:154px;color:var(--pm-text)!important}
.pm-editorial-thumb{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#eceefe}
.pm-editorial-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .35s ease}
.pm-editorial-card:hover .pm-editorial-thumb img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.pm-editorial-placeholder{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f0eaff,#cfd5ff);color:var(--pm-accent-dark);font-size:30px;font-weight:850}
.pm-editorial-copy{min-width:0;padding:17px 16px}
.pm-editorial-kicker{display:inline-flex;margin-bottom:8px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--pm-accent-soft);color:var(--pm-accent-dark);font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.pm-editorial-title{display:-webkit-box;margin:0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;color:var(--pm-text);font-size:17px;line-height:1.38;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.pm-editorial-desc{display:-webkit-box;margin:8px 0 0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;color:var(--pm-muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}
.pm-collection-heading{margin-top:58px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--pm-line)}
.pm-collection-heading .pm-section-head{margin-top:25px}
.pm-label-collection{margin-top:40px}
/* 개별 글 및 검색 결과: 기본 Blog1을 그대로 사용 */
body:not(.pm-home-view) .page_body .centered{padding-top:34px!important}

background:#fff!important;
border:1px solid var(--pm-line)!important;

box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-sm)!important;
padding:46px 54px!important;
}

body.item-view .post-body iframe{width:100%;border-radius:16px}
body.item-view #comments{border-top:1px solid var(--pm-line)!important;margin-top:32px!important;padding:30px 0 0!important}
body.item-view #vq-app{max-width:100%!important;margin-left:auto!important;margin-right:auto!important}
body.archive-view .Blog .blog-posts .post-outer-container,
body.label-view .Blog .blog-posts .post-outer-container,
body.search-view .Blog .blog-posts .post-outer-container,
body:not(.item-view):not(.pm-home-view) .Blog .blog-posts .post-outer-container{

float:none!important;
max-width:none!important;

  <h2>회피형 테스트란? 나의 연애 회피 레벨 알아보기</h2>
  <p><strong>회피형 테스트</strong>는 연인과 가까워질 때 내가 얼마나 거리를 두려고 하는지 알아보는 연애 심리테스트예요. 연락이 부담스럽거나, 다툰 뒤 잠수를 타고 싶거나, 관계가 깊어질수록 괜히 도망치고 싶다면 회피 성향이 있는지 확인해 볼 만해요.</p>
  <p>이 테스트는 12가지 연애 상황에서 고른 답을 점수로 바꿔 <strong>회피 지수</strong>를 계산하고, 그 점수에 따라 <strong>회피 레벨 1단계부터 5단계</strong>까지 보여 줘요. 약 2분이면 끝나고 무료로 할 수 있어요.</p>
  <h2>회피형이란? 회피형 연애의 특징</h2>
  <p>회피형은 애착이론에서 말하는 애착유형 중 하나로, 다른 사람과 가까워지거나 기대는 것을 불편하게 느끼는 성향을 말해요. 성인 애착 연구에서는 이를 <strong>친밀감 회피</strong>라고 부르고, 관계를 불안해하는 정도인 <strong>관계 불안</strong>과 함께 애착을 설명하는 두 축으로 봐요.</p>
  <ul>
    <li>혼자 있는 시간이 꼭 필요하고, 연락이 잦으면 부담을 느껴요</li>
    <li>힘든 일이 있어도 혼자 해결하려고 해요</li>
    <li>다툼이 생기면 대화보다 거리 두기를 택해요</li>
    <li>미래나 결혼처럼 무거운 이야기가 나오면 화제를 돌려요</li>
    <li>애정 표현을 요구받으면 오히려 움츠러들어요</li>
  </ul>
  <p>회피형이라고 해서 사랑하는 마음이 없는 건 아니에요. 가까워지는 것 자체가 낯설고, 상처받지 않으려는 마음이 거리 두기로 나타나는 경우가 많아요.</p>
  <h2>회피 레벨 5단계 한눈에 보기</h2>
  <img alt="회피형 테스트 결과 회피 레벨 1단계부터 5단계까지 한눈에 보기" loading="lazy" src="https://blogger.googleusercontent.com/img/b/R29vZ2xl/AVvXsEgjFlcRR8wccv6uka0Gz8ATk_krDvKw65hKS_0IiFYyy1ekAQR6Qx5jkB4BPRiA6uDvFtnlDKMfgdXcH-3L9gE0jakAlECjUpgnpcUjJXj_v1v_QmDSjQgn55TlQKQZzJumrWc46yzywABTWSXimU82Eh-mXPqdpkmVEWfn_feq_nc1qr7vG1yL25NtPUeA/s1600/avoidant-level-test-types.png">

    </tbody>
  </table></div>
  <h2>회피형과 불안형, 어떻게 다를까?</h2>
  <p>불안형은 상대가 떠날까 봐 걱정하고 더 가까워지려 하는 반면, 회피형은 가까워질수록 부담을 느끼고 멀어지려 해요. 그래서 두 유형이 만나면 한쪽은 쫓고 한쪽은 도망가는 패턴이 반복되기 쉬워요. 회피 레벨 1단계가 나왔다면 회피보다는 불안 성향을 함께 확인해 보는 것도 좋아요.</p>
  <h2>회피형 연인과 잘 지내는 법</h2>
  <ul>
    <li><strong>재촉하지 않기</strong>: 연락이나 애정 표현을 몰아붙일수록 더 멀어질 수 있어요.</li>
    <li><strong>혼자만의 시간 존중하기</strong>: 잠깐의 거리는 마음이 식었다는 뜻이 아니에요.</li>
    <li><strong>규칙을 함께 정하기</strong>: "연락이 어려우면 한 줄만 남기기"처럼 서로 편한 약속을 만들어 보세요.</li>
    <li><strong>작은 표현 칭찬하기</strong>: 회피형이 먼저 마음을 표현했다면 크게 반겨 주세요.</li>
  </ul>
  <h2>회피 성향, 바꿀 수 있을까?</h2>
  <p>애착 성향은 타고난 기질과 경험의 영향을 받지만 고정된 것은 아니에요. 안정적인 관계를 경험하거나, 내가 언제 부담을 느끼는지 알아차리는 연습을 하면서 점점 편안해질 수 있어요. 거리를 두고 싶을 때 사라지는 대신 이유와 돌아올 시점을 말로 알려 주는 것만으로도 관계가 크게 달라져요.</p>
  <h2>자주 묻는 질문</h2>
  <div class="q-faq"><h3>Q. 회피 레벨이 높으면 연애를 못 하나요?</h3><p>아니에요. 회피 성향이 높아도 자신의 패턴을 알고 연인과 대화로 약속을 만들면 충분히 행복한 연애를 할 수 있어요.</p></div>
  <div class="q-faq"><h3>Q. 결과가 할 때마다 달라요.</h3><p>요즘 연애 상황이나 컨디션에 따라 답이 달라질 수 있어요. 점수가 경계에 있다면 두 레벨의 특징을 함께 참고해 보세요.</p></div>
  <div class="q-faq"><h3>Q. 정식 심리검사인가요?</h3><p>아니에요. 애착이론의 개념을 바탕으로 만든 재미·자기이해용 테스트예요. 관계 때문에 많이 힘들다면 상담 전문가와 이야기해 보는 것을 권해요.</p></div>

      function imageFromHtml(html){
        html=html||'';
        var tmp=document.createElement('div');
        tmp.innerHTML=html;
        var first=tmp.querySelector('img[src],img[data-src],source[srcset]');
        if(first){
          var direct=first.getAttribute('src')||first.getAttribute('data-src')||first.getAttribute('srcset')||'';

        function cleanup(){
          if(script.parentNode)script.parentNode.removeChild(script);

/* =========================================================
PM CONTENT DISCOVERY DESIGN V5
Blogger 기본 위젯 구조는 보존하고 화면만 재구성합니다.
========================================================= */
:root{
--pm-bg:#ffffff;
--pm-surface:#ffffff;
--pm-soft:#f6f7fb;
--pm-text:#17181c;
--pm-muted:#777b85;
--pm-line:#e9eaf0;
--pm-accent:#5265f5;
--pm-accent-dark:#3e50d9;
--pm-accent-soft:#eef0ff;
--pm-shadow-sm:0 4px 16px rgba(27,31,55,.06);
--pm-shadow-md:0 14px 40px rgba(27,31,55,.10);
--pm-radius-sm:12px;
--pm-radius-md:20px;
--pm-radius-lg:28px;
--pm-max:1120px;
--pm-header:68px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
margin:0!important;
background:var(--pm-bg)!important;
color:var(--pm-text)!important;
font-family:Pretendard,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif!important;
font-size:16px;
line-height:1.55;
-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
body.pm-menu-open{overflow:hidden}
a{text-decoration:none}
.pm-container{width:min(calc(100% - 40px),var(--pm-max));margin:0 auto}
.pm-visually-hidden{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;padding:0!important;margin:-1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border:0!important}
/* Blogger 기본 외형 제거, 위젯과 게시물 데이터는 유지 */
.bg-photo-container,.bg-photo-overlay,.centered-top-container,.centered-top-placeholder,.sidebar-container{display:none!important}
.page{width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important}
.page_body{position:relative!important;z-index:1!important;background:transparent!important}
.page_body .centered{max-width:var(--pm-max)!important;min-height:0!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:34px 20px 70px!important}
.page_body .centered-bottom{padding:0!important}
#footer{display:none!important}
body.pm-home-view .page_body{
display:none!important;
}
/* 상단 헤더 */
.pm-site-header{
position:sticky;
top:0;
z-index:900;
height:var(--pm-header);
background:rgba(255,255,255,.93);
border-bottom:1px solid rgba(233,234,240,.92);
backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
}
.pm-header-inner{height:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.pm-icon-btn{width:42px;height:42px;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;padding:0;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;color:var(--pm-text)}
.pm-icon-btn:hover{background:var(--pm-soft)}
.pm-icon-btn svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.pm-brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;justify-self:start;min-width:0;color:var(--pm-text)!important}
.pm-brand-mark{width:36px;height:36px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:13px;color:#fff;font-size:22px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;background:conic-gradient(from 210deg,#5669ff,#985cff,#f062aa,#ffae45,#5669ff);box-shadow:0 9px 22px rgba(102,82,238,.3)}
.pm-brand-name{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-family:'Jua',Pretendard,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.015em;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#5746e8 0%,#8e4edb 45%,#e35b9a 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:#684de0;transform:rotate(-1deg);transform-origin:left center}
.pm-desktop-nav{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px}
.pm-desktop-nav a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;color:#555965!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:650}
.pm-desktop-nav a:hover{color:var(--pm-text)!important;background:var(--pm-soft)}
.pm-desktop-nav .pm-reading-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-left:4px;color:var(--pm-accent-dark)!important;background:var(--pm-accent-soft)}
.pm-desktop-nav .pm-reading-link:before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pm-accent)}
.pm-header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.pm-all-link{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--pm-accent);color:#fff!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:750}
.pm-all-link:hover{background:var(--pm-accent-dark);color:#fff!important}
/* 모바일 메뉴 */
.pm-drawer-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:950;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;background:rgba(15,17,25,.42);transition:.22s ease}
.pm-mobile-drawer{position:fixed;inset:0 auto 0 0;z-index:960;width:min(86vw,340px);padding:20px;transform:translateX(-102%);background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-md);transition:transform .25s ease;overflow-y:auto}
.pm-menu-open .pm-drawer-backdrop{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.pm-menu-open .pm-mobile-drawer{transform:translateX(0)}
.pm-drawer-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:24px}
.pm-drawer-brand{font-family:'Jua',Pretendard,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-size:25px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.015em;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#5746e8 0%,#8e4edb 45%,#e35b9a 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:#684de0}
.pm-drawer-nav{display:grid;gap:5px}
.pm-drawer-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 12px;border-radius:12px;color:var(--pm-text)!important;font-weight:650}
.pm-drawer-nav a:hover{background:var(--pm-soft)}
.pm-drawer-reading{margin-top:10px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--pm-line)}
.pm-drawer-reading>a{color:var(--pm-accent-dark)!important;background:var(--pm-accent-soft)}
.pm-drawer-reading-title{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.pm-drawer-reading-title svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.pm-drawer-reading-posts{display:grid;gap:2px;margin:8px 4px 0}
.pm-drawer-reading-posts:empty{display:none}
.pm-drawer-reading-posts a{display:block;min-width:0;padding:8px 10px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:9px;color:#5d65a8!important;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.35;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.pm-drawer-reading-posts a:hover{background:var(--pm-accent-soft)}
.pm-drawer-note{margin:24px 0 0;padding:16px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--pm-accent-soft);color:#4b55a7;font-size:13px}
/* 검색창 */
.pm-search-layer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:980;display:grid;place-items:start center;padding:12vh 20px 30px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;background:rgba(21,23,32,.52);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);transition:.2s ease}
.pm-search-layer.pm-open{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.pm-search-box{width:min(100%,640px);padding:18px;border-radius:22px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.pm-search-form{display:flex;gap:10px}
.pm-search-input{flex:1;min-width:0;height:52px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--pm-line);border-radius:14px;outline:0;color:var(--pm-text);background:#fff}
.pm-search-input:focus{border-color:var(--pm-accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--pm-accent-soft)}
.pm-search-submit{height:52px;padding:0 20px;border:0;border-radius:14px;color:#fff;background:var(--pm-accent);font-weight:750;cursor:pointer}
.pm-search-help{margin:12px 4px 0;color:var(--pm-muted);font-size:13px}
/* 홈페이지 */
.pm-home-main{padding:28px 0 78px;background:#fff}
.pm-hero-shell{position:relative;margin-bottom:44px}
.pm-hero-slider{position:relative;min-height:385px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--pm-radius-lg);background:#e8eaff;box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-sm)}
.pm-hero-slide{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateX(18px);transition:opacity .45s ease,transform .45s ease;color:var(--pm-text)!important}
.pm-hero-slide.pm-active{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translateX(0)}
.pm-hero-copy{z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:52px 34px 62px 58px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f1f2ff 0%,#e5e8ff 100%)}
.pm-hero-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-self:flex-start;margin-bottom:18px;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.76);color:var(--pm-accent-dark);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em}
.pm-hero-title{display:-webkit-box;max-width:520px;margin:0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;font-size:clamp(31px,4.1vw,52px);line-height:1.14;letter-spacing:-.055em;color:var(--pm-text)}
.pm-hero-desc{display:-webkit-box;max-width:520px;margin:17px 0 24px;overflow:hidden;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;color:#5c6070;font-size:15px}
.pm-hero-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;align-self:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:13px 18px;border-radius:999px;color:#fff;background:var(--pm-accent);font-size:14px;font-weight:750}
.pm-hero-media{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#d9dcff}
.pm-hero-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.pm-hero-media:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(229,232,255,.35),transparent 30%)}
.pm-hero-placeholder{width:100%;height:100%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 32%,rgba(255,255,255,.86) 0 10%,transparent 10.5%),radial-gradient(circle at 35% 70%,rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0 13%,transparent 13.5%),linear-gradient(135deg,#94a0ff,#5c6df0)}
.pm-hero-dots{position:absolute;z-index:5;left:58px;bottom:23px;display:flex;gap:6px}
.pm-hero-dot{width:7px;height:7px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(54,61,110,.25);cursor:pointer;transition:width .2s ease,background .2s ease}
.pm-hero-dot.pm-active{width:22px;background:var(--pm-accent)}
.pm-content-section{margin-top:46px}
.pm-section-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:18px}
.pm-section-title{margin:0;font-size:24px;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.045em;color:var(--pm-text)}
.pm-section-subtitle{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--pm-muted);font-size:14px}
.pm-section-more{flex:0 0 auto;color:#626774!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:700}
.pm-section-more:hover{color:var(--pm-accent)!important}
.pm-card-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px 18px}
.pm-card-rail{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:calc((100% - 54px)/4);gap:18px;overflow-x:auto;overscroll-behavior-inline:contain;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;padding:2px 2px 14px;scrollbar-width:thin}
.pm-card{min-width:0;scroll-snap-align:start}
.pm-card-link{display:block;color:var(--pm-text)!important}
.pm-card-thumb{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1/1;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--pm-radius-md);background:#eceefe;box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-sm)}
.pm-card-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .35s ease}
.pm-card-link:hover .pm-card-thumb img{transform:scale(1.035)}
.pm-card-placeholder{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#909cff,#5365ee);color:#fff;font-size:36px;font-weight:850}
.pm-card-badge{position:absolute;left:12px;top:12px;min-width:32px;height:32px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:var(--pm-accent-dark);font-size:12px;font-weight:850;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.09)}
.pm-card-title{display:-webkit-box;margin:13px 2px 0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.025em;color:var(--pm-text);font-weight:750}
.pm-card-meta{margin:7px 2px 0;color:#9296a0;font-size:12px}
.pm-empty{padding:40px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--pm-line);border-radius:18px;color:var(--pm-muted);text-align:center;background:var(--pm-soft)}
.pm-loading{min-height:385px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#73798b;font-weight:650}
/* 검색 유입용 읽을거리: 테스트 카드와 구분되는 매거진형 카드 */
.pm-editorial-section{padding:28px;border:1px solid #e1e4ff;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fbfbff,#f7f8ff)}
.pm-editorial-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}
.pm-editorial-card{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--pm-line);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-sm);transition:transform .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease}
.pm-editorial-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-md)}
.pm-editorial-link{display:grid;grid-template-columns:124px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:154px;color:var(--pm-text)!important}
.pm-editorial-thumb{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#eceefe}
.pm-editorial-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .35s ease}
.pm-editorial-card:hover .pm-editorial-thumb img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.pm-editorial-placeholder{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f0eaff,#cfd5ff);color:var(--pm-accent-dark);font-size:30px;font-weight:850}
.pm-editorial-copy{min-width:0;padding:17px 16px}
.pm-editorial-kicker{display:inline-flex;margin-bottom:8px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--pm-accent-soft);color:var(--pm-accent-dark);font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.pm-editorial-title{display:-webkit-box;margin:0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;color:var(--pm-text);font-size:17px;line-height:1.38;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.pm-editorial-desc{display:-webkit-box;margin:8px 0 0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;color:var(--pm-muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}
.pm-collection-heading{margin-top:58px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--pm-line)}
.pm-collection-heading .pm-section-head{margin-top:25px}
.pm-label-collection{margin-top:40px}
/* 개별 글 및 검색 결과: 기본 Blog1을 그대로 사용 */
body:not(.pm-home-view) .page_body .centered{padding-top:34px!important}

background:#fff!important;
border:1px solid var(--pm-line)!important;

box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-sm)!important;
padding:46px 54px!important;
}

body.item-view .post-body iframe{width:100%;border-radius:16px}
body.item-view #comments{border-top:1px solid var(--pm-line)!important;margin-top:32px!important;padding:30px 0 0!important}
body.item-view #vq-app{max-width:100%!important;margin-left:auto!important;margin-right:auto!important}
body.archive-view .Blog .blog-posts .post-outer-container,
body.label-view .Blog .blog-posts .post-outer-container,
body.search-view .Blog .blog-posts .post-outer-container,
body:not(.item-view):not(.pm-home-view) .Blog .blog-posts .post-outer-container{

float:none!important;
max-width:none!important;

/* =========================================================
PM CONTENT DISCOVERY DESIGN V5
Blogger 기본 위젯 구조는 보존하고 화면만 재구성합니다.
========================================================= */
:root{
--pm-bg:#ffffff;
--pm-surface:#ffffff;
--pm-soft:#f6f7fb;
--pm-text:#17181c;
--pm-muted:#777b85;
--pm-line:#e9eaf0;
--pm-accent:#5265f5;
--pm-accent-dark:#3e50d9;
--pm-accent-soft:#eef0ff;
--pm-shadow-sm:0 4px 16px rgba(27,31,55,.06);
--pm-shadow-md:0 14px 40px rgba(27,31,55,.10);
--pm-radius-sm:12px;
--pm-radius-md:20px;
--pm-radius-lg:28px;
--pm-max:1120px;
--pm-header:68px;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
body{
margin:0!important;
background:var(--pm-bg)!important;
color:var(--pm-text)!important;
font-family:Pretendard,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,"Segoe UI",sans-serif!important;
font-size:16px;
line-height:1.55;
-webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
body.pm-menu-open{overflow:hidden}
a{text-decoration:none}
.pm-container{width:min(calc(100% - 40px),var(--pm-max));margin:0 auto}
.pm-visually-hidden{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;padding:0!important;margin:-1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0,0,0,0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important;border:0!important}
/* Blogger 기본 외형 제거, 위젯과 게시물 데이터는 유지 */
.bg-photo-container,.bg-photo-overlay,.centered-top-container,.centered-top-placeholder,.sidebar-container{display:none!important}
.page{width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important}
.page_body{position:relative!important;z-index:1!important;background:transparent!important}
.page_body .centered{max-width:var(--pm-max)!important;min-height:0!important;margin:0 auto!important;padding:34px 20px 70px!important}
.page_body .centered-bottom{padding:0!important}
#footer{display:none!important}
body.pm-home-view .page_body{
display:none!important;
}
/* 상단 헤더 */
.pm-site-header{
position:sticky;
top:0;
z-index:900;
height:var(--pm-header);
background:rgba(255,255,255,.93);
border-bottom:1px solid rgba(233,234,240,.92);
backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
-webkit-backdrop-filter:blur(16px);
}
.pm-header-inner{height:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:22px}
.pm-icon-btn{width:42px;height:42px;display:inline-grid;place-items:center;padding:0;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:50%;cursor:pointer;color:var(--pm-text)}
.pm-icon-btn:hover{background:var(--pm-soft)}
.pm-icon-btn svg{width:22px;height:22px}
.pm-brand{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;justify-self:start;min-width:0;color:var(--pm-text)!important}
.pm-brand-mark{width:36px;height:36px;display:grid;place-items:center;flex:0 0 auto;border-radius:13px;color:#fff;font-size:22px;font-weight:900;line-height:1;background:conic-gradient(from 210deg,#5669ff,#985cff,#f062aa,#ffae45,#5669ff);box-shadow:0 9px 22px rgba(102,82,238,.3)}
.pm-brand-name{overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap;font-family:'Jua',Pretendard,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-size:24px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.015em;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#5746e8 0%,#8e4edb 45%,#e35b9a 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:#684de0;transform:rotate(-1deg);transform-origin:left center}
.pm-desktop-nav{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:6px}
.pm-desktop-nav a{padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;color:#555965!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:650}
.pm-desktop-nav a:hover{color:var(--pm-text)!important;background:var(--pm-soft)}
.pm-desktop-nav .pm-reading-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin-left:4px;color:var(--pm-accent-dark)!important;background:var(--pm-accent-soft)}
.pm-desktop-nav .pm-reading-link:before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--pm-accent)}
.pm-header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:4px}
.pm-all-link{padding:10px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--pm-accent);color:#fff!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:750}
.pm-all-link:hover{background:var(--pm-accent-dark);color:#fff!important}
/* 모바일 메뉴 */
.pm-drawer-backdrop{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:950;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;background:rgba(15,17,25,.42);transition:.22s ease}
.pm-mobile-drawer{position:fixed;inset:0 auto 0 0;z-index:960;width:min(86vw,340px);padding:20px;transform:translateX(-102%);background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-md);transition:transform .25s ease;overflow-y:auto}
.pm-menu-open .pm-drawer-backdrop{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.pm-menu-open .pm-mobile-drawer{transform:translateX(0)}
.pm-drawer-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-bottom:24px}
.pm-drawer-brand{font-family:'Jua',Pretendard,-apple-system,BlinkMacSystemFont,'Segoe UI',sans-serif;font-size:25px;font-weight:400;line-height:1;letter-spacing:.015em;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#5746e8 0%,#8e4edb 45%,#e35b9a 100%);-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;-webkit-text-fill-color:transparent;color:#684de0}
.pm-drawer-nav{display:grid;gap:5px}
.pm-drawer-nav a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:14px 12px;border-radius:12px;color:var(--pm-text)!important;font-weight:650}
.pm-drawer-nav a:hover{background:var(--pm-soft)}
.pm-drawer-reading{margin-top:10px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid var(--pm-line)}
.pm-drawer-reading>a{color:var(--pm-accent-dark)!important;background:var(--pm-accent-soft)}
.pm-drawer-reading-title{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:9px}
.pm-drawer-reading-title svg{width:18px;height:18px}
.pm-drawer-reading-posts{display:grid;gap:2px;margin:8px 4px 0}
.pm-drawer-reading-posts:empty{display:none}
.pm-drawer-reading-posts a{display:block;min-width:0;padding:8px 10px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:9px;color:#5d65a8!important;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;line-height:1.35;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}
.pm-drawer-reading-posts a:hover{background:var(--pm-accent-soft)}
.pm-drawer-note{margin:24px 0 0;padding:16px;border-radius:16px;background:var(--pm-accent-soft);color:#4b55a7;font-size:13px}
/* 검색창 */
.pm-search-layer{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:980;display:grid;place-items:start center;padding:12vh 20px 30px;opacity:0;visibility:hidden;background:rgba(21,23,32,.52);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);transition:.2s ease}
.pm-search-layer.pm-open{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.pm-search-box{width:min(100%,640px);padding:18px;border-radius:22px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.pm-search-form{display:flex;gap:10px}
.pm-search-input{flex:1;min-width:0;height:52px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--pm-line);border-radius:14px;outline:0;color:var(--pm-text);background:#fff}
.pm-search-input:focus{border-color:var(--pm-accent);box-shadow:0 0 0 4px var(--pm-accent-soft)}
.pm-search-submit{height:52px;padding:0 20px;border:0;border-radius:14px;color:#fff;background:var(--pm-accent);font-weight:750;cursor:pointer}
.pm-search-help{margin:12px 4px 0;color:var(--pm-muted);font-size:13px}
/* 홈페이지 */
.pm-home-main{padding:28px 0 78px;background:#fff}
.pm-hero-shell{position:relative;margin-bottom:44px}
.pm-hero-slider{position:relative;min-height:385px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--pm-radius-lg);background:#e8eaff;box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-sm)}
.pm-hero-slide{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.05fr .95fr;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transform:translateX(18px);transition:opacity .45s ease,transform .45s ease;color:var(--pm-text)!important}
.pm-hero-slide.pm-active{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto;transform:translateX(0)}
.pm-hero-copy{z-index:2;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;padding:52px 34px 62px 58px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#f1f2ff 0%,#e5e8ff 100%)}
.pm-hero-eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-self:flex-start;margin-bottom:18px;padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.76);color:var(--pm-accent-dark);font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em}
.pm-hero-title{display:-webkit-box;max-width:520px;margin:0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;font-size:clamp(31px,4.1vw,52px);line-height:1.14;letter-spacing:-.055em;color:var(--pm-text)}
.pm-hero-desc{display:-webkit-box;max-width:520px;margin:17px 0 24px;overflow:hidden;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;color:#5c6070;font-size:15px}
.pm-hero-cta{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;align-self:flex-start;gap:8px;padding:13px 18px;border-radius:999px;color:#fff;background:var(--pm-accent);font-size:14px;font-weight:750}
.pm-hero-media{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#d9dcff}
.pm-hero-media img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.pm-hero-media:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(229,232,255,.35),transparent 30%)}
.pm-hero-placeholder{width:100%;height:100%;background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 32%,rgba(255,255,255,.86) 0 10%,transparent 10.5%),radial-gradient(circle at 35% 70%,rgba(255,255,255,.55) 0 13%,transparent 13.5%),linear-gradient(135deg,#94a0ff,#5c6df0)}
.pm-hero-dots{position:absolute;z-index:5;left:58px;bottom:23px;display:flex;gap:6px}
.pm-hero-dot{width:7px;height:7px;padding:0;border:0;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(54,61,110,.25);cursor:pointer;transition:width .2s ease,background .2s ease}
.pm-hero-dot.pm-active{width:22px;background:var(--pm-accent)}
.pm-content-section{margin-top:46px}
.pm-section-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;margin-bottom:18px}
.pm-section-title{margin:0;font-size:24px;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.045em;color:var(--pm-text)}
.pm-section-subtitle{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--pm-muted);font-size:14px}
.pm-section-more{flex:0 0 auto;color:#626774!important;font-size:14px;font-weight:700}
.pm-section-more:hover{color:var(--pm-accent)!important}
.pm-card-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:22px 18px}
.pm-card-rail{display:grid;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:calc((100% - 54px)/4);gap:18px;overflow-x:auto;overscroll-behavior-inline:contain;scroll-snap-type:x proximity;padding:2px 2px 14px;scrollbar-width:thin}
.pm-card{min-width:0;scroll-snap-align:start}
.pm-card-link{display:block;color:var(--pm-text)!important}
.pm-card-thumb{position:relative;aspect-ratio:1/1;overflow:hidden;border-radius:var(--pm-radius-md);background:#eceefe;box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-sm)}
.pm-card-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;transition:transform .35s ease}
.pm-card-link:hover .pm-card-thumb img{transform:scale(1.035)}
.pm-card-placeholder{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#909cff,#5365ee);color:#fff;font-size:36px;font-weight:850}
.pm-card-badge{position:absolute;left:12px;top:12px;min-width:32px;height:32px;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:0 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);color:var(--pm-accent-dark);font-size:12px;font-weight:850;box-shadow:0 4px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.09)}
.pm-card-title{display:-webkit-box;margin:13px 2px 0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;font-size:16px;line-height:1.4;letter-spacing:-.025em;color:var(--pm-text);font-weight:750}
.pm-card-meta{margin:7px 2px 0;color:#9296a0;font-size:12px}
.pm-empty{padding:40px 20px;border:1px dashed var(--pm-line);border-radius:18px;color:var(--pm-muted);text-align:center;background:var(--pm-soft)}
.pm-loading{min-height:385px;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#73798b;font-weight:650}
/* 검색 유입용 읽을거리: 테스트 카드와 구분되는 매거진형 카드 */
.pm-editorial-section{padding:28px;border:1px solid #e1e4ff;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fbfbff,#f7f8ff)}
.pm-editorial-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px}
.pm-editorial-card{min-width:0;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--pm-line);border-radius:18px;background:#fff;box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-sm);transition:transform .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease}
.pm-editorial-card:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-md)}
.pm-editorial-link{display:grid;grid-template-columns:124px minmax(0,1fr);min-height:154px;color:var(--pm-text)!important}
.pm-editorial-thumb{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#eceefe}
.pm-editorial-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;display:block;object-fit:cover;transition:transform .35s ease}
.pm-editorial-card:hover .pm-editorial-thumb img{transform:scale(1.04)}
.pm-editorial-placeholder{width:100%;height:100%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#f0eaff,#cfd5ff);color:var(--pm-accent-dark);font-size:30px;font-weight:850}
.pm-editorial-copy{min-width:0;padding:17px 16px}
.pm-editorial-kicker{display:inline-flex;margin-bottom:8px;padding:4px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--pm-accent-soft);color:var(--pm-accent-dark);font-size:11px;font-weight:800}
.pm-editorial-title{display:-webkit-box;margin:0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;color:var(--pm-text);font-size:17px;line-height:1.38;letter-spacing:-.03em}
.pm-editorial-desc{display:-webkit-box;margin:8px 0 0;overflow:hidden;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;-webkit-line-clamp:2;color:var(--pm-muted);font-size:12px;line-height:1.55}
.pm-collection-heading{margin-top:58px;padding-top:6px;border-top:1px solid var(--pm-line)}
.pm-collection-heading .pm-section-head{margin-top:25px}
.pm-label-collection{margin-top:40px}
/* 개별 글 및 검색 결과: 기본 Blog1을 그대로 사용 */
body:not(.pm-home-view) .page_body .centered{padding-top:34px!important}

background:#fff!important;
border:1px solid var(--pm-line)!important;

box-shadow:var(--pm-shadow-sm)!important;
padding:46px 54px!important;
}

body.item-view .post-body iframe{width:100%;border-radius:16px}
body.item-view #comments{border-top:1px solid var(--pm-line)!important;margin-top:32px!important;padding:30px 0 0!important}
body.item-view #vq-app{max-width:100%!important;margin-left:auto!important;margin-right:auto!important}
body.archive-view .Blog .blog-posts .post-outer-container,
body.label-view .Blog .blog-posts .post-outer-container,
body.search-view .Blog .blog-posts .post-outer-container,
body:not(.item-view):not(.pm-home-view) .Blog .blog-posts .post-outer-container{

float:none!important;
max-width:none!important;
